highlights: Third-generation humanoid redesigned around Figure Helix vision-language-action control
Palm cameras and compliant tactile fingertips support grasp feedback
Soft washable coverings and foot-mounted wireless charging support the home-oriented design

The current product page lists 5 ft 8 in height, 61 kg mass, 20 kg payload, 1.2 m/s speed and five hours of runtime. The earlier 168 cm/60 kg catalog description is superseded; the approximate metric height conversion is labeled as such.

A 2.3 kWh pack supports the claimed five hours at peak performance, and foot coils accept 2 kW inductive charging. The charging rate is not a full-charge duration, and docking remains a precondition for near-continuous operation.

BotQ's first line is described as capable of up to 12,000 robots per year with a goal of 100,000 over four years. The April 29, 2026 report claims more than 350 Figure 03 units produced at one robot per hour. Production volume is not a customer delivery count.

The October 9, 2025 launch claims twice the camera frame rate, one-quarter latency and a 60% wider field of view per camera, plus fingertip sensors that detect forces as small as three grams. These are supplier claims without independent test results.

Figure 02's 11-month BMW Spartanburg deployment logged 90,000+ parts loaded, 1,250+ runtime hours and 30,000+ X3 vehicles. The 5 mm placement tolerance in two seconds, over 99% success and zero interventions were stated targets, not verified results.

The June 30, 2026 BMW Hall 52 sequencing workflow is described as the first Figure 03 demonstration. A demonstration does not establish a production fleet, autonomous reliability or broad commercial deployment.

The battery article targets UN and UL certification. UN38.3 is described as achieved by October 2025, while UL2271 remains in process; no independent certification, coverage of every revision or third-party safety test was reviewed.

The 11-month BMW Spartanburg deployment ran ten-hour shifts Monday to Friday, loaded 90,000+ parts, logged 1,250+ runtime hours and contributed to 30,000+ X3 vehicles. Cumulative runtime is not a mean time between failures.

companyFocus.name: Figure
highlights: Helix combines visual, language and action modeling for perception, reasoning and motion
The AI system is distinct from Figure robot generations; demonstrations do not establish performance on every task

Company history dates founding in 2022, Figure 01 first steps in May 2023, Figure 02 unveiling on August 6, 2024 and Figure 03 introduction on October 9, 2025. The generations are separate robot models, not software revisions.
Helix, Helix 02 and Helix 2.5 are AI systems, not additional robot models. The dishwasher and BMW sequencing demonstrations are supplier demonstrations, not independent autonomy tests.

Figure reports more than 350 Figure 03 units produced by April 29, 2026 at one robot per hour with over 80 functional tests per unit. Produced units are not proven customer deliveries or general availability.
Figure 02 BMW results and Figure 03 production figures are company-published. No independent performance, safety, delivery or market-leadership certification was reviewed.
